# gezor_roles (Data Source)

Built-in and custom roles in a workspace. `by_key` maps role keys (for example `admin`) to role ids.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_roles" "all" {}

output "admin_role_id" {
  value = data.gezor_roles.all.by_key["admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `by_key` (Map of String)
- `roles` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
